spec_gaps.description: feat-prove-routing's behavior sentence also says 'the unmanaged path always errors', which is INV-ROUTE-2's territory, but its falsifier cites only INV-ROUTE-1 and INV-ROUTE-3. Not treated as an ambiguity: INV-ROUTE-2 (explicit error naming the path when no ancestor pom.xml exists) is already the falsifier's own scope at the build-feature level (feat-project-router, whose falsifier separately cites [INV-ROUTE-2]). This plan deliberately covers only what feat-prove-routing's falsifier actually cites -- routing-collapse-to-reactor-root and no-drift-across-calls -- and does not add a condition for the unmanaged-path error path here, to avoid inventing scope beyond the falsifier this plan traces to.
